questions.question: Name the four Geography topics that Grade 6 learners study, one for each term.
questions.expected_answer: Term 1 is map skills with a focus on the world, Term 2 is trade, Term 3 is climate and vegetation around the world, and Term 4 is population, or why people live where they do.

questions.question: Explain what the equator is and how it divides the Earth.
questions.expected_answer: The equator is an imaginary line around the middle of the Earth, halfway between the North Pole and the South Pole. It divides the Earth into the Northern Hemisphere and the Southern Hemisphere, and South Africa is in the Southern Hemisphere.

questions.question: Explain why a direction must always be given from a fixed point, using an example.
questions.expected_answer: A direction only makes sense when we know where we are measuring from. For example, Kimberley is south-west of Pretoria, but Pretoria is north-east of Kimberley. If the fixed point changes, the direction changes too.
